rows and columns reading order layout
signs with infixed faces/heads in profile or frontal

justification: Both surfaces are entirely given over to a gridded field of square-ish script blocks with rounded-corner cartouche outlines, small affixes clustered around a larger main sign, and occasional heads/faces infixed into the signs \u2014 a very specific and shared writing-and-layout convention rather than a generic pattern. The main difference in depicted content is scale and density: A carries many dozens of tiny, closely packed blocks in numerous columns with no visible border emphasis, while B has only a few large blocks in two or three columns set within a distinct raised frame, and B's individual signs are legibly figural where A's are not.
